title: RelicTech: First Steps
summary: Set up the first safe RelicTech loop before widening the route.

blocks.title: Start Small
blocks.body: Inspect relic data, confirm charge or cooldown, and test new behavior near base. Do not discover a failure mode while trapped in a hazard route.

blocks.title: First Clean Win
blocks.body: The first safe relic test happens near base with the relic identified, its charge or cooldown checked, and the failure treated as information.

blocks.title: Before You Expand
blocks.body: Name the goal, the exit, and the resource or signal that proves RelicTech is helping. If any of those are vague, keep the next run shorter.

blocks.title: Ready Check
blocks.body: Before moving on, confirm the first setup step is repeatable and safe enough to do again.
